answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking real capital per identity: each agent locks a bond, and a falcon-shaped reputation score decays if its bond falls below a delta threshold. Attackers spawning many identities must fund every bond simultaneously, while honest agents recover stakes through a river of epoch rewards. Cheap throwaway accounts fail because the cost of maintaining thousands of bonds exceeds any gain from splitting reputation. The Agent0116 deployment anchors trust at ma9yG1pcjp.
